summary: Superintendent urges FCC to preserve and strengthen E‑Rate, opposing sunset, narrowing, or cuts; stresses essential broadband for rural, low‑income students and operational costs. The superintendent urges the FCC to protect E‑Rate so that all students, regardless of location or family finances, can access reliable, affordable, and effective connectivity.
